title: Weekly email digest notification setting
purpose: Document a candidate handoff for a member-controlled weekly email digest setting in notification settings, including persistence across sign-out and sign-in, independence from account-security messages, and the default state for newly created members.

scope.text: This handoff covers a member-facing switch for weekly email digests in notification settings, persistence of that setting across sign-out and sign-in, continued delivery of account-security messages when digests are off, and the default digest state for newly created members.

requirements.text: Members can switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
The setting must persist after sign-out and sign-in.
Switching digests off does not disable account-security messages.
A newly created member starts with weekly digests off.

stories.text: As a member, I want to switch weekly email digests on or off in notification settings.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member is in notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests off, then that member's weekly email digest setting is off.
Given a member is in notification settings, when the member switches weekly email digests on, then that member's weekly email digest setting is on.

stories.text: As a member, I want my weekly email digest setting to persist after I sign out and sign in again.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member switched weekly email digests off, when the member signs out and signs in and opens notification settings, then the weekly email digest setting is shown as off.
Given a member switched weekly email digests on, when the member signs out and signs in and opens notification settings, then the weekly email digest setting is shown as on.

stories.text: As a member, I want account-security messages to remain enabled when I switch weekly email digests off.
acceptance_criteria: Given a member has switched weekly email digests off, when an account-security message is sent to that member, then the account-security message is still delivered to that member.

stories.text: As a newly created member, I start with weekly email digests off.
acceptance_criteria: Given a newly created member who has not changed notification settings, when that member's weekly email digest setting is read, then weekly email digests are off.

edge_cases.text: Verify the digest setting is unchanged after a member signs out and signs in for both the on and off states.
Verify that account-security messages are still sent to a member whose weekly email digests are off.
Verify that a newly created member's digest setting is off before the member changes any notification setting.

dependencies.text: Owner and delivery date are unknown.
The mechanism used to store and restore the member's digest setting across sign-out and sign-in is not specified and requires confirmation.

risks.text: Delivering a weekly email digest to a newly created member before that member switches digests on would not meet REQ-4.
Losing the stored digest setting at sign-out or sign-in would not meet REQ-2.
Suppressing account-security messages as part of switching digests off would not meet REQ-3.

success_metrics.text: Verify by test that a member's weekly email digest setting reads the same after sign-out and sign-in as it did before.
Verify by test that account-security messages are still delivered to members whose weekly email digests are off.
Verify by test that a newly created member's weekly email digest setting is off.

open_questions: Where and how is the digest setting stored so that it persists after sign-out and sign-in?
What defines the weekly delivery schedule for digests, and in which time zone is it evaluated?
What setting should existing members have, given that the brief only specifies the start state for a newly created member?
Which account-security messages are covered by the statement that switching digests off does not disable them?
